end.summary: Named cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying solid shapes using familiar objects and checking features such as flat faces and curved surfaces. Aditya correctly used examples like a cup, ball and candle, and counted two flat faces for a cylinder. They mixed up shape names when an object was turned and called every box a cube; these mix-ups were not corrected by the end. At home, ask them to name objects from different positions and check whether all faces are equal squares before saying “cube.”
